name: W17 Morning Flow — Bodyweight Spine + Hip (All Days, Rotated Variety)
description: 15 min bodyweight floor flow — universal W17 morning flow, used every training day (Mon push / Tue KB / Wed pull / Thu KB / Fri legs). Same three-part shape as W11-W16 with rotated moves for variety. Three-part: spine primer → bodyweight work → deep stretch arc. Day-specific therapeutic add-on at the end (push = pec-minor protocol; pull = dead hang + scap pull; legs = cross-leg lateral lean + pigeon + supine twist; KB days skip — banded prep covers it).

exercises.notes: Slow, full ROM each direction. Spine wave wakes the segment-by-segment articulation.

Rotates in for W17 — 45s each side. From a low lunge, plant the inside hand and rotate the top arm open to the ceiling, eyes following the hand. Hip flexor lengthen + thoracic rotation in one shape — opens the front of the hip and the mid-back together.

Standing, knees soft, torso hinged slightly forward. Tight fists with thumbs tucked, rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension — the wrist dials a stretch up the back chain. Stays in the primer.

sets.name: Work Block — Bodyweight Activation (~5 min)

exercises.notes: **Greasing set — 1 quick set, NEVER to failure.** Daily frequency is the point, not max effort (same idea as the pull-up greasing set — the floor rises over time). Elbows ~45° (not flared), ribs down, glutes tight, body one line, **pack down not up.** Stop 2-3 reps short. Back off / drop to knees if the right shoulder talks at the bottom.
Feet flat, drive through the heels, squeeze the glutes to a tall bridge, ribs down — no arching the lower back. Posterior-chain wake-up.
Rotates in for W17 — 30s. On the back, opposite arm + leg extend and return, lower back PRESSED into the floor the whole time. Anti-extension core; the floor counterpart to the bird-dog.
30s each side. Anti-rotation — opposite arm + leg extend, hold a beat, hips stay square (no swinging).
Rotates in for W17 — slow walkouts. From a forward fold, walk the hands out to a plank, hold a beat, walk back. Dynamic hamstring + shoulder + core warm-up that wakes the whole front line.
30s each side. The windmill on the floor — lateral-hinge cue translation. Thread the top arm under the body, then reach it back to the ceiling.

sets.notes: Opens with a pushup greasing set (1 quick set, never to failure — daily habit). Dead bug + inchworm rotate in for variety; glute bridge + bird-dog (anti-rotation) stay.

sets.name: Yoga Flow — Deep Stretch Arc (~7 min)

exercises.notes: 30s each side. Stays every week — signature spine move.

Rotates in for W17 — knees wide, shins parallel, sink the hips back toward the heels. Deep adductor + medial-hip opener; the adductors take a beating on KB days + the wide-stance leg work. Ease in slowly, breathe.
30s each side. Hip flexor + adductor + back-leg quad. Drop to elbows if accessible. Stays — durable hip opener.
Bodyweight, slow. Stays every week — mirrors the Tuesday loaded cossack.

Rotates in for W17 — sit in a wide straddle, reach toward one foot, then center (chest toward the floor), then the other foot. Slow, breathe into each reach. Straddle + adductor + hamstring opener — the wide-leg shape the CLAUDE.md flow design calls for.
30s each side. Long hold on the hip release to close the arc.

sets.notes: Continuous arc — flow between shapes, breathe deeply. Anchors stay (scorpion, lizard, cossack BW); frog stretch + straddle reaches join and pigeon closes for W17.

sets.name: 📍 Day-Specific Add-On — Pick by Today's Training (~3-5 min)

exercises.notes: **📍 PUSH DAYS — KEY PROTOCOL MOVE.** 30s each at LOW / MID / HIGH elbow positions. Arm bent 90°, forearm on the door frame, step through and rotate the torso AWAY. Desk work continuously re-tightens pec minor — daily.
**📍 PUSH DAYS** — active side of the pec-minor fix. Lower trap + rotator cuff.
**📍 PUSH DAYS** — serratus activation, helps unstick a tight pec minor.
**📍 PUSH DAYS (optional)** — slow rotator cuff work. Add if the shoulder feels off.
**📍 PUSH DAYS (optional)** — pins the shoulder blades in the corrected position.
**📍 PULL DAYS** — 25s. Decompress the shoulders, warm the grip.
**📍 PULL DAYS** — scapulae retracting only, no elbow bend. Crisp scap engagement before loaded pulls.
**📍 LEGS DAYS** — 30s each side. Scissor one foot over the other, reach the same-side arm overhead, lean away from the back leg — QL/psoas release. Also in the legs-workout warmup.
**📍 LEGS DAYS — W8 QL-SPASM PROTOCOL.** 90s each side. Long hold lets the QL/psoas release. Non-negotiable on legs day.
**📍 LEGS DAYS** — 60s each side. Gentle twist for the QL. Lacrosse-ball QL roll above the iliac crest beforehand if available.

sets.notes: **Pick today's day-specific protocol — push / pull / legs.** ~3-5 min total. KB days (Tue/Thu) skip this block — the in-workout banded prep covers the equivalent.

tips: Same shape as W11-W16, rotated moves. Morning flows stay low-fatigue; variety keeps them fresh.
**15 min main flow + 3-5 min day-specific add-on** — universal across W17 (Mon push / Tue KB / Wed pull / Thu KB / Fri legs).
**Scorpion + cossack BW + lizard pose stay every week** — durable anchors.
**Low-lunge thoracic rotation, dead bug, inchworm, frog stretch, straddle reaches rotate in for W17** variety.
**Day-specific add-on at the end** — push days do the pec-minor protocol, pull days do dead hang + scap pull, legs days do cross-leg lean + 90s pigeon + supine twist. KB days skip the add-on.
If short on time: low-lunge rotation + lizard + cossack BW + pigeon, plus today's day-specific add-on.
formPhilosophy: Same as W11-W16 — variety means different shapes hitting the same patterns. Scorpion-family spine work + hip openers + adductor/straddle stretches. The low-lunge thoracic rotation joins as the primer's hip+mid-back opener; dead bug + inchworm freshen the work block; frog + straddle reaches deepen the adductor arc. Morning flows stay structured around the in-workout banded prep's logic on KB days, and the day-specific protocols on PPL days.
